title: Collaboration workspace
tagline: Presence, comments, room activity and analytics tracking with Junco
description: A hands-on Junco collaboration demo. Explore the complete fake-data UI or connect to the hosted disposable Liveblocks room when the service is configured.
features: Fake mode includes presence, comment threads, replies, reactions, history, sharing and room activity
Optional real room connects to the Junco-hosted Liveblocks demo auth endpoint
Privacy-safe typed analytics events are shown in a local event log
Private application rooms still use the application's own sign-in and access checks
